meta.title: Table 1. Brain Research Study (BRS)

eacLock.note: Clinical Core locks RPPR metrics to the EAC window through 10/13/2026. Table row counts reflect Data Core QC on the 10/7 MAP pull until Xinhui refreshes through 10/13.

sources: James harmonized UDS / Milestones (Sep 16 package — may lag live MAP updates)
NP core (Carol) for one 2026 withdrawal not yet in MAP
meta.referenceNote: Percent column uses current enrollment as denominator (past RPPR algorithm).

currentEnrollmentDefinition: Active participants with autopsy consent signed on or before the EAC lock date (10/13/2026) who remained active as of the Data Core QC snapshot (MAP pull 2026-10-07); excludes MAP-active subjects without finalized UDS packet (no Flywheel UDS/milestone data).

methodology.cumulativeEnrollment: Active or minimal contact in both MAP BRS and harmonized UDS/milestones as of data pull; MAP-only active without UDS packet removed from count.
methodology.withdrawal: date_of_termination with subject_brs_status = Withdraw; plus NP-reported withdrawal pending MAP entry (2026).
methodology.deathsWithAutopsy: Cross-check date_of_death, autopsy_performed_date, autopsy_number; reconcile with der_status_adrc when MAP incomplete.
methodology.deathsWithoutAutopsy: date_of_death in window without autopsy performed per QC rules.

qcNotes: MAP BRS and UDS milestones may lag death/autopsy data entry; CC/NP updates after James Sep 16 harmonized export will not appear in that package.
Five subjects active in MAP without finalized UDS were excluded from N=226 (would be N=231 if counted).
James package CSVs are snapshots (Sep 16 + Oct 9 supplements); activity after export delivery is not in harmonized files even when the EAC window extends to 10/13/2026.
